name: Subsidy Enhancements
summary: Subsidy countdowns: Offer Countdown, Reward Countdown, and Subsidy Ring Colors by phase
description:
Improvements to subsidies. Each feature can be turned off in the mod's Settings (the gear next to the mod when choosing a game's mods). Settings also has a Logging switch, off by default, that writes the mod's messages to the game log (stdout.txt) for bug reports.

Offer Countdown: a subsidy offer stays open for about six months, then it is withdrawn, but the game never shows how long you have left to accept it. With this mod an offer you haven't accepted yet shows its time left as a bar, drawn like the countdown the game shows once a subsidy is accepted: in the Subsidy Available notification and in the subsidy's window, under Decline and Accept. The bar empties as the offer runs out. The calendar line on an offer still shows the time you get to fulfil it once accepted.

Reward Countdown: once a subsidy is fulfilled, its reward runs for a set time (2x income on the supplying lines or the connection for five years), but its Subsidy Effect Active notification shows no time left. With this mod it shows a bar with the reward's time left, in the notification and in the subsidy's window.

Subsidy Ring Colors: in the notification list, the ring around an accepted subsidy's icon is yellow while the subsidy is in progress and green while its reward runs, so both phases stand apart at a glance from offers, which keep the white ring.

Only the display is changed: subsidies, their timing and their rewards stay as the game sets them. The mod saves nothing with your game, so it can be removed at any time.
